scope: Follow-up source inspection for T736 8 GiB LPDDR4 normal boot without any Tina runtime binary
conclusion: No usable source-only LPDDR4 initializer was found in the inspected candidates. This is not a proof that no such implementation exists anywhere.

candidates.finding: Branch head unchanged; DRAM driver's commit documents LPDDR5 controller, PMU firmware, geometry decoding and board swizzle. Existing isolated source compile does not implement LPDDR4.
Documented source PMU is LPDDR5. Host driver presets LPDDR5 rails and implements LPDDR5 controller/MR8 sizing. Not imported or executed.
LPDDR4 config explicitly links precompiled libdram-lpddr4.a; C driver calls external init_DRAM. Does not satisfy source-only requirement. No source or binary imported.
LPDDR4 success commit explicitly uses Cubie A7Z board parameters from a Radxa-derived source. Excluded on provenance; audit stopped after detecting this. No code or parameters imported.

remaining_required_inputs: LPDDR4 host-controller and DDR PHY programming/training implementation suitable for T736
Board-verified LPDDR4 wiring, geometry, timings and voltage setup
Independent SRAM SPL integration and tested early eMMC/TF-A handoff
next_validation: A complete source-built SPL must initialize LPDDR4 from power-on before a compliant raw image can be built and tested.
